data.narrative:
Fairmat operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at the Series B stage, having raised approximately $103M to date. The peer universe comprises nine comparable companies: one public entity (277810.KQ) and eight private firms including Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity, all at similar stage and sector positioning.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline of $27M, applied a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B progression, yielding an implied valuation of $51M. Peer-median benchmarking across the three closest same-stage, same-sector comparables—Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B)—produced a median valuation of $1.8B, with a range of $1.6B to $2.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $44M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $901M. The substantial spread reflects two distinct methodological views: stage-progression implies a relatively conservative $51M, while peer-median analysis points to approximately $1.8B. This divergence hinges on whether Fairmat's efficiency, traction, or market position materially exceeds typical capital-raise multiples for the stage. Key uncertainties include revenue scale, unit economics relative to peers, and time-to-next round. The peer-median method carries greater weight given direct comparability; however, the low-end scenario merits consideration if Fairmat's commercialization lags peer trajectories.
